message: ふたり
Once Melilot-san and Paqy left, it was just the two of us.
Because the library is so well soundproofed, no noise from outside could be heard at all.
Only the ticking of the clock, which I hadn't even paid attention to until a moment ago, echoed strangely loud.
It felt like we were the only two people in the world.
A sudden silence.
We're really all alone......

name: Azel
message: 「Synn, um, well」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, ah, what?」
Saying that, Azel turned her face to the side for some reason.

name: Azel
message: 「N-no, it's nothing......」

name: Synn
message: 「Now I'm curious」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-you don't need to worry about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「But」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm telling you, you don't need to worry about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「......Then, well. I actually have something I want to say too」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-what is it」
Trying to put it into words now makes me feel embarrassed.

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. Is it okay if I move a little closer?」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-what did you say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, s-sorry. Never mind--」

name: Azel
message: 「N-no, that's not it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, but......」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I was actually just about to, um, say the same thing......」
I want to pull her into a tight hug right then and there, but I hold myself back and scoot my chair closer.
Our chairs touch. Without either of us initiating it first, our hands overlap.
Azel's hand was smooth and felt wonderful.

name: Azel
message: 「It's strange... Just doing this makes my heart beat faster and faster」

name: Synn
message: 「Mine too」

name: Azel
message: 「U-Um, you see, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Can I get a little closer?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Idiot! That's what I was just about to say!」
We snuggle up closely, pressing our shoulders together.
Azel's head rests lightly on my shoulder.
The scent of her hair tickles the tip of my nose.

name: Azel
message: 「Hehe. You smell like Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Do I stink? I've been taking showers, though I have been pulling all-nighters...」

name: Azel
message: 「No. Not that kind of smell」

name: Azel
message: 「It makes me feel at ease, knowing I'm right here with you...」

name: Synn
message: 「...You smell really nice too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Idiot. D-Don't say something so embarrassing...」
Though she said that out loud, Azel didn't try to pull away.

name: Azel
message: 「Still... hearing you say that... doesn't feel bad...」
We stayed like that for a while, taking in each other's warmth and scent.

name: Azel
message: 「Coming to this world has truly changed me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You love this world now, after all」
Warmth radiates even from our arms pressed tightly together.
She laces her fingers through mine, and I lace mine back.

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I love it. This world filled with beautiful things, where I met you, Melilot, and my Leica」
Suddenly, Azel looked up at my face.

name: Azel
message: 「More than anything, more than anyone, I love you, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
As if drawn to the lips right in front of me, I kissed her.
Our lips brushed for just a brief second before parting.

name: Azel
message: 「W-W-W-W-What was that just now!?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. It's just, you said something so heart-pounding, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I merely spoke my honest thoughts! Never mind that--I am asking what you just did!」
Even though Azel was the one who did it earlier, they didn't know the name of the act?

name: Synn
message: 「...A kiss」

name: Azel
message: 「A... kiss?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」
My cheeks grow hot.

name: Azel
message: 「A kiss... I see... So it is called a kiss...」
Suddenly, something warm and soft pressed against my lips.
A sweet numbness, like an electric shock, shot straight to the top of my head.
A contact just a little bit longer than before.

name: Azel
message: 「Haah...」
We slowly pull apart, as if reluctant to let go.

name: Azel
message: 「I see... A kiss... I-It is a wonderful thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. It's amazing」

name: Azel
message: 「It makes you feel so close, Synn... Having someone else touch my lips ought to be repulsive, yet when it is you, it is different」
Turning their face away, Azel was bright red all the way to their earlobes.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want to do it with anyone else either, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course! I wouldn't want to do it with anyone other than you either, Synn」

name: Azel
message: 「B-But, if it is with you, well...」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to kiss only you too, Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Idiot, don't just blurt out what I was about to say--」
Azel's eyes, gazing at me, were moist.
Reflected within them was my own face, gazing back at Azel.
